description: Icon Map Pro is the enterprise mapping visual for Power BI that brings high-performance, multi-layer spatial analytics to everyday Power BI users, with no specialist GIS tools. Drop in your fields and build almost any map: circles sized and colored by your data, donut and pie clusters, icons and images, heatmaps, hexagon grids raised into 3D, 3D columns, glowing arcs and flows on a spinning globe, side-by-side routes, and boundaries from your own data, ArcGIS or a catalog of more than 3,000 ready-made layers. Set it on one of 35+ built-in basemaps or your own, add satellite imagery and 3D terrain, and it still behaves like a native Power BI visual, with cross-filtering, drill-down and report page tooltips. Data layers More than 20 data layers, all driven by your Power BI data and conditional formatting Circles, icons and images (including SVG from your data), with donut, pie, bar, column, square and teardrop clusters Heatmaps, and H3, S2, A5 and Geohash grids with 3D extrusion Aggregate points into your own uploaded shapes, such as sales territories or service areas, with sum, count, average, min or max 3D columns and extruded polygons Lines: straight, great-circle, 3D arcs with animated comets, flows, flow arcs, flow trees and side-by-side routes Shapes from WKT or GeoJSON in your data, uploaded or linked files, vector tiles, ArcGIS layers and the Icon Map Catalog Data labels…
